governing_rule: Every material A/B-discriminating observable must be the declared revision-equivalence treatment, a deterministic consequence of that treatment, or explicitly blocked/non-causal under the frozen environment boundary.

statistical_note.identification_limit: With only two treatment states, Phi_path itself identifies arm label, so ordinary sample conditional-MI estimation is not informative.
statistical_note.operationalization: Condition on the full declared equivalence relation M_Gamma by masking its content and preregistered deterministic consequences; then require exact paired identity of the residual observable vector across treatment-equivalent metamorphic encodings. Blind classifiers operate only on that residual vector.

declared_treatment.semantic_object: equivalence relation over the 24 frozen revision-path IDs
declared_treatment.descriptor: Phi_path = structural summary of Gamma conditional on the shared validated substrate; Phi_path is not the complete treatment object
treatment_entitled_observables: any statistic computed solely from M_Gamma without access to non-treatment state

artifact: path-record payload and ordering after canonicalization
implementation: shared environment-kernel source and call path
metadata: serialization fingerprint not implied by M_Gamma
inference: all residual observable features after declared-treatment masking

predeclared_dispositions.wall_clock_cpu_cycles_joules_cache_misse: OUT_OF_SCOPE_NONCAUSAL_UNLESS_EXPOSED_OR_USED_FOR_STOPPING; predicate E uses deterministic logical opportunity

blind_recovery_attack.class_balance: exactly one A and one B per residual signature pair
blind_recovery_attack.pass_rule: All 64 A/B metamorphic pairs have identical residual signatures and every holdout classifier accuracy is exactly 0.5. Exact paired identity is primary; classifier failure is secondary.

automatic_fail: any material residual A/B mismatch after declared-treatment masking
any arm/evaluator-visible raw Gamma label, repository arm label, or undeclared identifier
different implementation or exception path outside the declared matrix content
any material undeclared observable that supports above-chance paired label recovery
